One of them, holding a bow, crouches down to interact with a large, reptilian flying creature that lands nearby. The creature then runs and takes flight, and the humanoid runs alongside it before stopping to watch it fly away. Character 2: man with a beard and messy brown hair, wearing a grey t-shirt with a graphic and white pants. Character 3: man in a police uniform, wearing a dark police uniform with a tie and badge. Character 4: man with glasses and a light grey polo shirt, wearing a light grey polo shirt with dark stripes and light pants. Character 5: man with a mustache and dark hair, wearing a dark shirt and khaki pants. Character 6: woman in a police uniform, wearing a dark police uniform with a tie and badge. Character 7: group of children sitting at desks, wearing various casual clothes. Object 1: whiteboard with writing and diagrams. Object 2: American flag. Object 3: blue flag with a star. Object 4: map of Las Vegas on a stand. Object 5: bookshelf filled with binders and books. Object 6: desks and chairs. Object 7: clipboard. Setting: classroom with light blue walls, desks, whiteboards, and flags. Live-action footage. Wide shot, left-heavy composition. Characters 1 and 3 are standing on the left. Character 2 is standing next to Character 1. Character 4 is standing next to Character 2. Character 5 is standing on the right leaning against a wall to the right of Character 4. Character 6 is standing behind Character 2. Character 7 is sitting at desks facing the front. Object 1 is on the wall. Objects 2 and 3 are standing in the corner. Object 4 is on a stand. Object 5 is against the right wall. Object 6 is arranged in rows. Object 7 is held by Character 5. Character 3, the man in a police uniform, walks across the front of the classroom while Character 1, the man with dark hair, Character 2, the man with a beard and messy brown hair, and Character 4, the man with glasses, stand and watch. Character 5, the man with a mustache and dark hair, leans against the wall holding a clipboard. By the end of the shot, Character 3 is walking to the right. Reference 1 shows Character 1, Character 2 and Character 4; Reference 2 shows Character 2, Character 3 and Character 4.
